title: FeNi bimetallic oxides derived from MOFs as precursors promote efficient electrochemical synthesis of ammonia
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01074D, Paper
Jiuqing Xiong, Yanli Zhang, Yifan Wang, Haoyu Zhang, Shengwei Huang, Shihai Yan, Bingping Liu
Both experimental results and theoretical data indicate that the synthesized NiFe2O4 is a high-yield and efficient catalyst with great potential in sustainable ammonia production and wastewater treatment.
